doe_2007.title: U.S. Mining Industry Energy Bandwidth Study
doe_2007.evidence: Engineering benchmark, not a global adoption forecast
doe_2007.boundary: Grinding energy only; metal-mining current/best-practice requirements are 57900/49200 Btu per ton, rounded here to a 15% reduction.

mcivor_2023.title: Development of Fine High-Pressure Grinding for Mineral Processing Plants
mcivor_2023.evidence: Plant audits and comparative pilot testing, with circuit-design estimates
mcivor_2023.boundary: Machine energy only. Wider reported savings (54% secondary circuit, 30% plant comminution at Copper Mountain) include auxiliaries and grinding-media embodied energy and must not be applied uniformly to electricity.

aydogdu_2024.title: A Systems Engineering Approach to Decarbonizing Mining: Analyzing Electrification and CO2 Emission Reduction Scenarios for Copper Mining Haulage Systems
aydogdu_2024.evidence: Modeled open-pit conveyor alternative; published efficiency assumptions
aydogdu_2024.boundary: Useful-work equivalence for selected haulage fuel energy. Not an empirical conversion for every diesel machine; original machinery is retained as a proxy unless additional inventory changes are supplied.

hustwit_sykes_1994.title: Pipeline Treatment of a Metal Mine Drainage Containing Copper and Zinc
hustwit_sykes_1994.locator: Table 2, mean dissolved-metal removal in second/third full-scale operational periods
hustwit_sykes_1994.evidence: Full-scale Penn Mine observations; different operational states, not statistical confidence bounds
hustwit_sykes_1994.boundary: Collected drainage while treatment operates. Does not establish capture coverage, lime/electricity/sludge burdens, or effectiveness over ecoinvent's long-term emission horizon.

sun_2025.title: Development and industrial validation of a novel fluidized flotation column for coarse copper tailings recovery
sun_2025.locator: Abstract and introduction; Dexing 6000 t/day coarse-tailings circuit
sun_2025.boundary: Recovery from coarse tailings into low-grade material, not finished copper. Further beneficiation, its recovery and its inventory are required. Fractions are Dexing-specific proxies when transferred elsewhere.
